lyrics:
[Intro: plain piano chords, soft pedal steel]

[Verse 1: warm female alto, close]
Onions burning, radio low
Your shirt's on inside out
Our girl is laughing at her phone
Nobody's in a hurry, nobody's left the house

[Pre-Chorus: drums enter softly]
There's nothing here to photograph
That's how I know

[Chorus: full band, voice opening wide]
Keep this one
When the rest go soft and gray
The steam, the light, the way you turn around
Don't anybody move today
If I only get to carry one thing out
Keep this one

[Verse 2: voice fuller, guitar answering]
She'll be gone in two more summers
You'll be grayer, so will I
The dog won't make it to her wedding
And this window won't face this sky

[Pre-Chorus: drums build]
I'm not sad. I'm paying attention.
That's all it is

[Chorus: full band, voice opening wide]
Keep this one
When the rest go soft and gray
The steam, the light, the way you turn around
Don't anybody move today
If I only get to carry one thing out
Keep this one

[Bridge: piano and voice, breaking on the high note]
I've lost the big days, lost whole years
I couldn't tell you what I wore
But I will have this till I'm ash
You, a wooden spoon, a kitchen floor

[Final Chorus: biggest, held last note]
Keep this one
When the rest go soft and gray
The steam, the light, the way you turn around
Don't anybody move today
If I only get to carry one thing out
Keep this one

[Outro: piano, a smoke alarm chirps, everybody laughs]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 65 BPM, 4/4, A minor verses opening to C major choruses. Slow, warm and wide, a piano ballad with a country-rock band.

VOICE: Female alto, rich and slightly husky, almost spoken in the verses. In the choruses she belts with a controlled break at the top of her range, and holds the final note a long time.

INSTRUMENTS: An upright piano, pedal steel guitar, acoustic guitar, a warm electric guitar, bass, a drum kit played with restraint and big cymbal swells in the choruses, a small string section, a Hammond organ.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, piano. 0:12 Verse 1. 0:46 Pre-chorus. 0:56 Chorus 1. 1:28 Verse 2. 1:58 Pre-chorus. 2:08 Chorus 2. 2:40 Bridge. 3:00 Final chorus. 3:30 Outro, a smoke alarm and laughter, ends 3:38.

PRODUCTION & MIX: 2018 film-soundtrack country rock: live, warm and unpolished, piano and voice in front, band in a room.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: 'There's nothing here to photograph. That's how I know.' at 0:46.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The original freezes a romantic high point. By middle age the moments worth keeping are the ones in which nothing is happening, and you only know that because you have lost so many.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Noticing, aching, grateful, laughing.
